structure.layout: single-column unstyled HTML document: h1 title, h2 category headings each followed by stacked <details> feed sections with bulleted dated link lists, error list, and footer

aesthetics.typography: system-ui throughout (browser defaults) for headings, summaries, list items and links
aesthetics.typeScale: Browser default scale: h1 36px bold, h2 27px bold, everything else 18px regular; hierarchy from headings only

notes: Essentially unstyled HTML: default blue underlined links (#0000ee), native details/summary disclosure triangles, default bullets, feed URLs in light grey (#aaaaaa) in parentheses after each feed title. The only decoration is the 🦉 emoji in the H1 and a ❤️ in the footer. Some feeds (Changelog, Simon Willison) are open by default, apparently server-side. Errors section exposes raw fetch/parse error messages. Footer shows a 'Last updated' build timestamp, signalling a statically generated page.
